scoring_justification: Full recompute from raw NEB profiles is infeasible (only final barriers are submitted); result-level comparison to paper gold with tolerance captures the reproduction claim.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold migration barrier values for pristine LFP and Na-doped LNFP near Na site.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Advanced Materials 2023, Figure 1c and text: migration energy barrier of Li-ions in pristine LFP is 0.68 eV, and near Na site in LNFP is 0.38 eV.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from the paper's reported results.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Directly from the paper's published data; values are the ones the paper reports for the same systems and conditions.

outputs.description: The Li-ion migration energy barriers computed from NEB for the pristine LFP system and for the Na-doped LNFP system near the Na-occupied site.

output_contract.notes: The checker compares the two barrier values to the paper's reported values within a tolerance. No other files are required.

steps.description: Check that both barrier values are within ±0.05 eV of the paper-reported values.
